scope: Whole resident method versus native configurations; placement, dispatch and recurring control differ together.
uncertainty: One paired group per workload; descriptive ratios only, no confidence intervals or significance claims. Six sessions cannot estimate between-group or repeated-run variability.
warmup_state: Each server runs the same8 pilot requests twice. Native ON may change maps/history during warmup; HTTP drain does not attest an EPLB commit.
commit_and_numerical_limit: Native async normal commits remain unobservable in ordinary logs. Binding manifests and HTTP success do not establish all-layer numerical equivalence.
source_dependence: The two workloads share an Azure arrival block shape scaled to their previously frozen pilot rates; do not pool them as independent repetitions.
phase_scope: Each prompt generates exactly its previous natural-EOS OFF output-token count, with min_tokens=max_tokens=N and early stopping suppressed for all arms. Full prompts and absolute calendars are reused. Equal counts do not imply identical token identities, expert routing, batch shapes or answer quality. Native phase dominance is measured, not assumed.
